items.question: Which adornment and seat are attributed to the goddess described here?
premises: The goddess wears a waistband bound by thousands of various gems.
She is situated on a seat of pretas.
items.inference: Thus the verse depicts her with a gem-bound waistband and a preta seat.
uncertainties: Compound and case boundaries in the fused phrase are interpreted from context.
items.plain_english: She is situated on a preta seat, wearing a waistband bound by thousands of various gems.
